newsitem.title: USA: Elek-Tek in 3-year $50 mln credit pact.
newsitem.headline: Elek-Tek in 3-year $50 mln credit pact.

text.p: Elek-Tek Inc said Wednesday it has agreed to terms of a $50 million revolving credit pact with Deutsche Financial Services Corp and NationsCredit Commercial Corp of America.
This new facility, with a three-year term, replaces the company's existing one-year agreement with LaSalle National Bank, a unit of ABN Amro Holding NV.
Deutsche Financial Services Corp is a unit of Deutsche Bank Group, and NationsCredit Commercial Corp of America is a NationsBank Corp affiliate.
The pact includes an extended term and more favorable conditions and is expected to provide the company with considerably greater operating flexibility, Elek-Tek said.

Elek-Tek is a regional marketer of microcomputer products, including hardware, software, related accessories and supplies. Its distribution system comprises eight retail superstores, a national catalog sales operation and direct sales divisions for corporate, educational and government customers.
Shares of Elek-Tek closed off 3/16 at 4-3/8.
